title: DocMIDE: Learning Multi-Hop Implicit Derivation in Visually Rich Documents
abstract: arXiv:2609.24092v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world document processing systems rely on rigid, predefined schemas, yet critical target fields often lack direct visual counterparts on the page. Extracting these implicit values requires multi-hop derivation, such as aggregating sub-categories or reasoning over visual marks. While existing methods handle explicit text spans or simple implicit queries, they fail at multi-hop visual reasoning even after standard fine-tuning: models retrieve incorrect visual evidence, or retrieve it correctly and then skip the intermediate steps of the derivation. To address this, we introduce DocMIDE, a fine-tuning framework that trains compact vision-language models to retrieve visual evidence explicitly before deriving an answer. DocMIDE constrains generation to a plan-retrieve-derive structure and optimizes it with Group Relative Policy Optimization under a four-component, rule-based reward that scores output format, the retrieved evidence block,

translated_title: DocMIDE：在视觉丰富文档中学习多跳隐式推导
translated_abstract: 现实世界的文档处理系统依赖于僵化的、预定义的模式，然而关键的目标字段往往在页面上缺乏直接的视觉对应物。提取这些隐式值需要多跳推导，例如聚合子类别或对视觉标记进行推理。虽然现有方法能够处理显式文本片段或简单的隐式查询，但即使在标准微调之后，它们在多跳视觉推理上仍然失败：模型要么检索到错误的视觉证据，要么正确检索到证据后却跳过了推导的中间步骤。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DocMIDE，这是一个微调框架，用于训练紧凑的视觉语言模型在推导答案之前显式地检索视觉证据。DocMIDE将生成过程约束为“规划-检索-推导”的结构，并通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行优化，采用基于规则的四组件奖励，对输出格式、检索到的证据块进行评分……
tldr: DocMIDE是一个微调框架，通过“规划-检索-推导”的结构化生成和基于规则的强化学习奖励，训练紧凑的视觉语言模型在视觉丰富文档中显式检索证据并完成多跳隐式推导，从而解决关键字段缺乏直接视觉对应时的信息提取难题。
en_tdlr: DocMIDE is a fine-tuning framework that trains compact vision-language models to explicitly retrieve visual evidence before deriving answers, enabling multi-hop implicit derivation in visually rich documents through a plan-retrieve-derive generation structure optimized with rule-based reinforcement learning rewards.
